scenarios.name: Generate default and named-base instructions and preserve the task-owned destination at launch/relaunch
scenarios.oracle: Issue 3103 requires task-owned expected default or named integration base, independent of current forge destination.

scenarios.name: Register, accept readiness and recognize a merge only when the live forge destination matches
scenarios.oracle: Issue 3103 closure contract, across GitHub, GitLab, Forgejo and Gerrit supported paths.

scenarios.name: Reject mismatched, absent or unreadable forge destinations, retargets after readiness and moved heads without a merge call
scenarios.oracle: Issue 3103 forbids a ready/merged claim or forge merge call without matching available destination proof, while retaining head guards.

scenarios.name: Report one recovery blocker for legacy absent, duplicate, invalid or conflicting expected-base records
scenarios.oracle: Task-owned expected destination must be valid and unambiguous, never inferred from forge destination.

scenarios.name: Retry local and remote-spool parent delivery after a lost receipt without duplicating the blocker
scenarios.oracle: Maintainer follow-up in attached plan requires stable parent blocker identity for append-before-receipt interruptions. Same unchanged ledger event must remain one parent blocker.

execution_limits.blocked_probe: The command guard refused creation/execution of the localhost HTTPS forge emulator with: BLOCKED: System service modification not allowed. The emulator was not executed and no alternate tool/runtime/command was used to bypass that refusal.
execution_limits.forge_tools: gh exists on PATH. glab, tea and gerrit-axi do not. No host search or global installation performed. Fake forge CLI tests are supplementary behavioral evidence, not live forge validation.
